label: How This Relates to IFS P5 alone, dd ("a maze, with a little one somewhere in the middle of it", then "Is the maze a problem? Depends on who's walking you through it.")
his: My reparenting method diverges from IFS at an important point.
I emphasize the inner adult you build and practice occupying: Nurturer, Protector, and Leader, Guide, or Guru.
I have no use for another neo-Advaita, [spiritual-bypassing](https://goenka.u-dont-exist.com/) claim that a perfect Higher Self is already waiting underneath everything.

IFS calls these wounded young parts “exiles.” I find that pathologizing. I prefer to speak of a child who needs parenting and integration, rather than naming them by their wounded or excluded condition.
This framework developed through the teachers and collaborators credited below and my own practice.
I borrow particular distinctions and practices rather than presenting the whole synthesis as their consensus or claiming that their research validates it as a package.
